svg.title: Featured: Portfolio Assistant
svg.desc: Answers recruiter questions about my work and traces every claim to a source document. A question goes through BM25 and vector search, reciprocal rank fusion and an LLM reranker before the answer is written. 86 golden eval cases, recall at 10 of 0.99, 8 of 10 prompt injections resisted. A real exchange, captured 12 Oct 2026. What did he automate at Capgemini? At Capgemini, Shubham automated repetitive reporting tasks in incident tracking and follow-up using Python. He also built a Python tool that used a language model to turn prose access requests into proposed Active Directory account and access changes for his review, which saved roughly 2 to 5 hours of his own time a week. Sources: Putting a language model in front of Active Directory access requests, with me as the approval step; Keep a human approval step between the language model and Active Directory; The seven questions I get asked, and my actual answers.
